ValidationRule.description: Write a Validation Rule to throw an error message When a Employee whose qualification is NOT B.A, B.Com ,B.TECH and M.TECH selects the On calls OR Hybrid Course.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Employee_Qualification__c ,'B.A')) , NOT(ISPICKVAL(Employee_Qualification__c ,'B.Tech')) , NOT(ISPICKVAL(Employee_Qualification__c ,'B.Com')) , NOT(ISPICKVAL(Employee_Qualification__c ,'M.Tech')) , OR( ISPICKVAL(Employee_Mode_Of_approaching_Customer__c ,'On calls and Internet'), ISPICKVAL(Employee_Mode_Of_approaching_Customer__c ,'Hybrid') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Employee can't Choose On calls and Internet OR Hybrid Customer approach If his Qualification Is Not B.Tech, B.Com, M.Tech, B.A
